text:
Rae Turner: quick thread / finalize spec for model-catalog lifecycle lanes incl. contract impacts, auditability, and rollback SLOs. need one doc teams can point to.
Ilan Park: can we call out tenant-level audit logs for every migration event? customers will ask for proof of when/what changed.
Sofia Mehta: +1. require pre/post eval snapshot retention for 180 days, include random-sample diffs and a signed hash for tamper evidence.
Jonah Reed: ops ask: automated rollback SLO = 5m to redirect traffic to fallback model after a critical alert during canary, and 30m for bulk rollouts. document fallback selection logic.
Priya Shah: legal asks: permanent pins allowed only with explicit "pin_lock" clause and billing flag. need migration notice windows in contract: min 12 months for forced retires.
Rae Turner: suggestion: introduce three technical controls in the runbook: soft-pin TTL, shim-layer (compatibility adapter), and audit-lock (read-only ledger). how they interact: soft-pin delays automated rollouts, shim-layer handles tokenizer/kv-compat, audit-lock guarantees immutability for the pin entry.
Ilan Park: shim-layer detail: if tokenizer fingerprint mismatch -> attempt token-mapping shim for 30 days; if shim fails -> human stop. include sample shim config to wire into Console.
Sofia Mehta: perf/quality gates: require deterministic eval harness with seeds + user-sim load test. numeric gates (draft): Dedicated lane: p95 <= 120ms (<=128 tokens), eval intent delta <= 2.5%, cost delta <= +8%. Hosted: p95 <= 200ms, eval delta <= 2.0% for canary.
Jonah Reed: reliability gates: error_rate < 0.5% sustained, infrastructure error spikes must auto-fail canary. add guardrail: if fallback used > 0.5% of requests for 10m -> pause rollout.
Priya Shah: customer-facing timelines: Opt-in windows by lane: concierge 0-14d, standard 15-60d, deferred 61-180d, locked = contract. produce simple migration-table for sales.
Rae Turner: rollout config snippet for Console (UI wiring):
```
rollout:
  lanes:
    - id: concierge
      initial_pct: 10
      max_pct: 50
      duration_hours: 24
      monitors: [latency_p95, error_rate, eval_delta]
    - id: standard
      initial_pct: 5
      max_pct: 25
      duration_hours: 96
      monitors: [latency_p95, eval_delta]
  fallback_policy:
    immediate_on: [high_sev_safety, latency_spike]
    model_fallback: family-compat-quant
  shim_layer:
    enabled: true
    max_grace_days: 30
    auto_map_tokens: true
```
migrate-helper: queued run "audit-migration-preflight" on ded-aep-2, ETA 5361234600
Sofia Mehta: safety gates: critical_prompt_set of ~80 prompts, block if safety_trigger_count increases by >20% or any new high severity trigger appears. also require human review if open-ended tokens differ >30% from baseline in sample.
Ilan Park: telemetry: every migration event must emit migration_id, tenant_id, rollout_lane, pre_eval_hash, post_eval_hash, shim_used, rollback_trigger, and contract_pin_flag. store snapshots in cold storage for 180d.
Jonah Reed: rollback playbook: immediate fallback + alert -> run automated mitigation (traffic shift to fallback), then start incident runbook for triage. target MTTR < 60m for critical customer-impacting rollbacks.
Priya Shah: billing implications: credits for early opt-in: concierge 25% credits for 60d, standard 10% for 30d. permanent pin customers billed a premium for support/responsibility. legal to draft clause.
migrate-helper: run complete: median 99ms, p95 131ms, eval_delta 1.9%, safety_triggers stable -> PRE-FLIGHT PASS for concierge thresholds
Rae Turner: owners: Ilan -> telemetry + shim spec, Sofia -> eval harness + safety set, Jonah -> rollback playbook + SLOs, Priya -> contract text + billing, Rae -> migration runbook + console defaults. target PRs by 5361234610.
Rae Turner: we'll merge runbook once owners sign off; schedule canary 09:00 PT tomorrow. keep updates in-thread. :white_check_mark:
